sources.classification: labelled from the task code, 2026-10-10: a recommender (embeddings + MLP) fits no leaf workload, so `training`; precision fp32 (the 80 GB FP16 set passes no --amp; the rows' logs record amp False); params = (138 493 users + 26 744 items) x (64 + 128) embedding weights + MLP and final layers = 31.83 M; dataset_samples = MovieLens-20M ratings minus one test rating per user (20 000 263 - 138 493), each epoch adds 4 negatives per positive

measurements.source: Lambda, github.com/lambdal/deeplearning-benchmark, commit aa5addb6 (2025-12-17), pytorch/pytorch-train-throughput-fp16.csv, column ncf (training throughput, samples/s), single-GPU rows of 80 GB cards, run with batch 10 000 000 in fp32 (pytorch/pytorch-train-bs-fp16.csv; config_pytorch_80GB.sh, no ncf batch fix in the GPU configs): 'A100 80GB SXM4' 30787381; 'A100 80GB PCIe' 29393923; 'H100 80GB PCIe Gen5' 34483571, 'LambdaCloud H100 80GB PCIe Gen5' 34259182; 'H100 80GB SXM5' 52418903, 'Dell H100 80GB SXM5' 70240500, 'DellTexas H100 80GB SXM5' 70236923, 'SMC H100 80GB SXM5' 70202724, '1CC H100 80GB SXM5' 70271974, 'RAIDZ1 H100 80GB SXM5' 70284958; the logs of these rows (pytorch/results/<system>_v1/PyTorch_ncf_FP16) record amp False. measurements.anchor_compute_sec_note: training work / published throughput of 'A100 80GB SXM4': 2 epochs x 9 batches (99 308 850 samples per epoch: 19 861 770 positives  4 negatives each; last partial batch dropped) x batch 10000000 = 180 000 000 samples; / 30 787 381 samples/s. The benchmark's throughput covers the training steps: start-up, data download and validation are outside it
